original_contribution: Original opt-in terminal-failure inventory integrated into current Huey executor decisions; pre-mutation serialized attempt snapshots independent of results; atomic one-time detached redrive with fresh callback identities and durable lineage. Includes original explicit contract, independent behavioral verifier and reference implementation.

sources.finding: Current executor handles retry, timeout, lock, rate limit, cancellation and chord outcomes. Existing error results are conditional/consumable and do not preserve the full failed invocation. Result.reschedule needs an in-memory task and is not an atomic durable claim.
Inspected current Message format and nested callback/chord serialization. This reference preserves that wire format and stores lineage separately.
Current SQLite schema and transaction primitives inspected; no durable terminal-failure inventory or atomic redrive claim API found.

Public dead-letter/deserialization question is adjacent prior art. Its shipped 2.5.2 fix protects batch deserialization and does not implement this executed-terminal-failure archive. Malformed-message quarantine is explicitly out of scope.
Preserve shipped retry/backoff, terminal-error storage options and structured Error/SKIPPED chord behavior; do not claim these as new features.

public_solution_overlap.known: Result.reschedule, error results and public issue815 are explicitly distinguished from durable failure inventory and atomic detached replay. No exact complete feature implementation found in the checked current source/issues/PRs.
public_solution_overlap.limit: Bounded repository/source/issue search recorded in research/huey-sources.json, not exhaustive global fork search. Two final broad GitHub searches hit unauthenticated rate limits; source and web fallbacks were inspected.

horizon.rationale: Coordinates exact terminal classification, capture before mutation, optional results, serializer/schema compatibility, nested success/error callback identities, chord detachment, persistent lineage and atomic concurrent replay. This is the most likely of the three Huey features to prove too easy; only trial trajectories can establish sustained work and useful model headroom. Patch size is not a step-count measurement.

limitations: Requires on-disk SQLite; no Redis/distributed archive or malformed-message quarantine.
Durability starts when archive insertion commits; no worker lease or guarantee for process disappearance before recording.
Archive commit is not atomic with all executor result/callback/external effects.
Periodic invocations and deliberate cancellation are excluded from terminal failures.
Redrive intentionally detaches old chord coordination and clears absolute expiry; applications must request any new absolute deadline separately.
Failure records/receipts remain until explicit deletion; lineage links are retained independently and are not automatically garbage-collected.
Receipt result handles do not retain rescheduling argument data.
Docker validated on ARM64; AMD64 base is available but not independently run.
